facts.material: textile dress with drape, medallions, armbands

gri_path: GRI 1: heading 9505 festive, carnival articles; Chapter 95 note 1(e) excludes only well-made fancy dress of ch 61/62
GRI 3(b): dress gives essential character; raw unfinished edges, flimsy, so not apparel

rejected_alternatives.reason: dress is not well made (raw edges), so ch 62 apparel excluded from consideration

classification.rationale: Costume set whose dress has raw unfinished edges is flimsy, not wearing apparel; classified in 9505.90.60 consistent with Goddess costume rulings such as N327404.
